sourceReviewFacts: Surface event/probe closures capture the surface, not the source image. Detachable owner callbacks reach only their live painter and are unlinked at retirement; dispose clears callback references.
Each painter owns detachable subscriptions with distinct tokens; shared surfaces and other live painters survive retirement.
Normal cache invalidation retains both notified lost tokens and not-yet-notified tokens of an already-lost shared surface.
Appearance/level replacement and disposal retire all subscriptions; callbacks are detached before retirement notifications.
Healthy event-supported masks do no native polling; one 250ms native probe exists only for lost storage with live owners and a native query.
Restoration does no pixel work; the existing paused scene submits the rebuilt mask before explicit Resume can advance authority.
Stale timer token identity cannot clear or orphan a successor timer.
Native Canvas2D events never call preventDefault; premature restoration cannot override a true isContextLost.
The Solo host control exercises real scene pause/Resume and real character/backing helpers; full BoardPainter draw and native pixels remain fixture-modeled.
